Thanks for translating! It takes ten minutes and no programming.

1. Copy [`traduzioni/MODELLO.txt`](../../blob/master/traduzioni/MODELLO.txt).
2. Replace the English with your language, keeping the `Key = ` part.
3. Say your language here (for example "French") and paste the lines
   below. A partial translation is welcome.

The `{0}` and `{1}` slots must stay as they are. Everything else is yours.

## Your lines

```
Paste your translated lines here
```
